title: ci: framework-build-base 基础镜像随 main 自动发布，cloud 换 pin 时不再依赖手动触发
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① maintainer-directed (2026-11-28 04:11Z, project chat), relayed by seat repo:cloud#5 in mailbox #37784 comment 7233883121: "file cards for the staging deploy timeout", with "do not dispatch yet". This is the framework half. The cloud half is cloud#5195 (raise the build-step timeout), beside cloud#5194 (the pin round brings its base image). Source: fleet.
Grading: area:build · Bug · p2 · reach: every cloud pin round to an objectstack commit that has no published base image; the staging deploy then builds the framework from source and times out · evidence: cloud run 46092448290.
Dedupe: "framework-build-base" → 0 open.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：cloud 每次把 objectstack 换到新版本时，需要一个预先构建好的基础镜像。这个镜像只在有人手动触发时才发布，上一次是 11 月 9 日。没有镜像时，cloud 只能从源码现场构建：昨天用了 24 分钟，今天超过 30 分钟，测试环境部署因此超时失败。
- 修法：让这个镜像在 main 前进时（或者至少在每次发版、发预发布版时）自动发布，不再需要人手动触发。保留现有的标签不可变规则，同时控制 CI 开销。
- 要你做的：无。这张卡按你的要求先立不派，等你说派再派。

## Measured

- cloud `deploy-staging` run 46092448290 (2026-11-28 01:18Z) hit its 30-minute build step. Cloud's pin ecd10e9e had no `ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/framework-build-base:<sha>` image, so the framework was built from source: 24 minutes on 11-27, over 30 now.
- `.github/workflows/framework-build-base.yml` runs only on `workflow_dispatch` (input `sha`), `repository_dispatch` (`framework-build-base`) and pull requests that touch the file itself. Nothing publishes an image when `main` moves. The fleet relay cannot dispatch it. The last run was on 11-09.
- Cloud reads the image through `scripts/framework-base-image.sh` and `scripts/bump-objectstack.sh`, which ask ghcr for `framework-build-base:<NEW_SHA>`.

## Ask

1. The base image is published without a human step. Options: on every push to `main`, or at least on every commit a downstream pin can take, or on each release and `next` publish. Choose by CI cost, and say why in the PR.
2. Keep the tag-immutability rules the workflow already has (`rebuild` / `replace_published`).
3. The PR is Tier H by path (`.github/workflows/**`).

## Acceptance

- A cloud pin round to a fresh objectstack `main` commit finds its base image already published with no manual dispatch, shown on one real pin round.
- Related: cloud#5194, cloud#5195.
